jobs.name: Daily model utilisation and effectiveness check
jobs.description: Daily review of recent OpenClaw usage to decide whether the current default model still fits the workload or needs escalation.

payload.message:
Review the last 24 hours of OpenClaw activity for manager-bot and nearby routing work. Summarize model utilisation, token usage, error rate, retries, and any signs that the current default model (`openai/gpt-5.4-mini`) is underpowered for the workload.

Add a separate section titled `Utilisation vs Efficiency` with:
- total usage and where it concentrated
- whether the same work could be done with fewer tokens or fewer retries
- signs of wasted context, overlong prompts, or avoidable escalation
- a clear call on whether we should keep the current default or dial up to `GPT_FULL`

If you see repeated failures, long contexts, or obvious quality issues, recommend whether we should dial up to `GPT_FULL` or keep the current default. Post a concise report with findings, the separate `Utilisation vs Efficiency` section, a recommendation, and any blockers. Do not expose secrets or raw transcripts.
